description: Browse the Guides for one jurisdiction or domain (for example every Guide for 'MT', or every 'payroll' Guide), each with its quality tier and verification status. For a specific topic, search_skills is quicker. Filter by jurisdiction, domain or role ('foundation' | 'compute' | 'orchestrator' | 'reference'). Paginated (default 100, max 200); page with offset/next_offset.

domain.description: Filter by accounting domain: income-tax, vat-gst, payroll, bookkeeping, e-invoicing, formation, financial-statements, transfer-pricing, tax-optimization, crypto, cross-border, corporate-tax, estate-wealth-tax, references, sector-guidance, tooling.

offset.description: Number of skills to skip — use the next_offset from the previous response to page through results (default 0).

role.description: Filter by pipeline role: foundation, compute, orchestrator, reference.

name: list_skills

limit.description: Page size applied to this response.

next_offset.description: Present when more results remain — pass as offset to fetch the next page.

total.description: Total skills matching the filter (across all pages).
